### Day 36: 1 Samuel 28:1–7
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-36-1-samuel-28-17.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 28:6
Points:
- Saul faced the gathering Philistines with terror and sought God, but the Lord remained silent.
- God does not withhold answers arbitrarily; unconfessed, persistent sin separates us from hearing His voice.
- Although Saul experienced occasional regret, he consistently refused genuine repentance and righteous obedience.
- When God seems silent in our lives, He may be waiting for us to acknowledge and deal with specific sin.
- Sincere confession and turning from sin must always come before asking God for deliverance from difficult circumstances.
